observations.title: Use Minecraft-themed menu cursors
observations.player_action: Move the pointer over supported interface elements and adjust cursor settings.
observations.outcome: The pointer can use context-specific textures and animations supplied by compatible resource packs.
conditions: Installed 3.11.3 is the old Minecraft Cursor generation; the project is now renamed Cursors Extended.
External documentation is not installed-runtime proof; inspect the installed artifact/configuration before relying on defaults or exact compatibility.
observations.review_note: Presentation/settings alone do not provide an inventory completion signal. Any quest would require a documented native action or explicit manual confirmation.

observations.title: Match cursor packs to the mod generation
observations.player_action: Check whether a cursor resource pack targets v3 or v4 before enabling it.
observations.outcome: The author states packs across the 1.21.9 generation boundary are incompatible without conversion.
conditions: Newer settings paths and converter output must not be assumed appropriate for JEM's 1.20.1 release.
